claim_boundary: These US occupation research signals are transferred only through reviewed detailed-title identities. They do not measure Singapore adoption, employment effects or job-loss probability and cannot change the ILO headline.

source_code_match.anthropic_observed_exposure: six-digit parent SOC code published by the source; source title and grain stay visible

eloundou.publication_title: GPTs are GPTs: An Early Look at the Labor Market Impact Potential of Large Language Models
eloundou.construct: Share-equivalent theoretical task exposure under the paper's beta rubric: direct LLM exposure plus half-weighted exposure requiring complementary software.

anthropic_observed_exposure.publication_title: Labor market impacts of AI: A new measure and early evidence
anthropic_observed_exposure.construct: Platform-observed occupational exposure combining theoretical task feasibility with work-related Claude usage and greater weight for automated than augmentative use.
anthropic_observed_exposure.code_system: Six-digit US SOC codes derived from O*NET tasks

mapping.method: official SSOC 2024 to ISCO-08, official ESCO to O*NET-SOC candidate relation, reviewed detailed occupation identity, then the source occupation code

eloundou_theoretical_exposure.interpretation: Higher values mean more tasks were judged directly exposed to an LLM or exposed with complementary software under the beta rubric. This is potential, not observed adoption.

anthropic_observed_exposure.interpretation: Higher values mean more theoretically feasible tasks were observed in work-related Claude usage, with automated use weighted more than augmentative use. This is platform evidence, not Singapore adoption.

derived_theory_use_gap.interpretation: Eloundou beta minus Anthropic observed exposure. A larger positive gap indicates more theoretical scope than observed Claude use in the source periods; it is not a forecast.
